doctrine: Read by leviathan.graphrag.write_guard at every plan_write, inside the evidence-build container (this file rides the image beside driver_slices.yaml; configs/graphrag/eval/ does not), and by the fold's census gate (e1_census --diff) through the same loader and the same rule. One entry admits ONE slice's refusable population drop, and only while (a) the entry is in force (declared_on <= today <= expires, UTC; past expires it is ignored and the refusal stands), (b) the pass LANDS the declared change: the before-side still reads as one of the PRE-CHANGE readings in prior_population (within SLICE_DROP_REFUSE of the live object's measured pre-change population, or of the fold's older census baseline) and the new population reads as none of them -- once the store has moved off the pre-change readings the entry is SPENT, whatever the slice grows to afterwards, and the plain 10% line judges every later drop -- and (c) the new population sits within SLICE_DROP_REFUSE of expected_population -- the guard's own 10% line re-based onto the declaration, no new threshold. A span contraction on the same slice is admitted endpoint by endpoint, only on a pass that lands the declared change and only as far inward as expected_span declares (zero days past it). Every other slice, the empty guard and the layer line are untouched. Strict schema: prior_population and expected_population are REQUIRED (every prior reading at least SLICE_DROP_REFUSE above expected_population; a span-only entry is refused because it could never be seen to land); unknown keys, relative expected_drop_pct, bad dates or a duplicate slice make the WHOLE file invalid and nothing is admitted (fail closed). Tracked with `git add -f` (configs/graphrag/* is gitignored).

The live object (13,632,657 B, written 2026-08-21T21:21:03Z) predates the narrowing, so the first fold after it judged the declared post-narrowing population (133) against the stale pre-narrowing slice and refused (corpus-fold-h13c, 2026-09-23, 77.2% drop). The narrowing removes the world-pool props that set all four span endpoints, so the measured post-narrowing endpoints are declared as expected_span.
